mapper.select: SELECT entity_no, party_id, status, acquiring_qualification FROM t_operating_entity WHERE entity_no IN (SELECT entity_no FROM t_client_entity_affiliation WHERE client_id = #{clientId}) ORDER BY entity_no
SELECT entity_no, party_id, status, acquiring_qualification FROM t_operating_entity WHERE entity_no = #{entityNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_operating_entity SET acquiring_qualification = #{qualification}, update_time = #{now} WHERE entity_no = #{entityNo}
mapper.sql: (SELECT NULLIF(COALESCE(o.legal_name, TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' ', i.given_name, i.middle_name, i.family_name))), '') FROM t_party_profile pp LEFT JOIN t_organization_profile o ON o.profile_id = pp.profile_id LEFT JOIN t_individual_profile i ON i.profile_id = pp.profile_id WHERE pp.party_id = ${partyColumn})

SELECT e.entity_no AS entityNo, e.party_id AS partyId, e.operating_country AS operatingCountry, e.status AS status, e.acquiring_qualification AS acquiringQualification, AS legalName, s.source_relation_id AS sourceRelationId, s.source_type AS sourceType, s.source_client_id AS sourceClientId, s.source_partner_id AS sourcePartnerId, s.effective_from AS sourceEffectiveFrom, s.effective_to AS sourceEffectiveTo, p.partner_no AS providerPartnerNo, p.party_id AS providerPartyId, p.status AS providerStatus, AS providerLegalName, COALESCE(r.current_version, 1) AS changeVersion FROM t_operating_entity e LEFT JOIN t_entity_source_relation s ON s.entity_no = e.entity_no AND s.active_source_slot = 1 LEFT JOIN t_local_partner p ON s.source_type = 'PARTNER' AND p.local_partner_id = s.source_partner_id LEFT JOIN t_business_change_record r ON r.record_type = 'OPERATING_ENTITY' AND r.record_id = e.entity_no AND r.parent_history_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_operating_entity e LEFT JOIN t_entity_source_relation s ON s.entity_no = e.entity_no AND s.active_source_slot = 1
